def solve(h, n, sum, is_move_left)
  return sum if h == 0

  left_all_nodes  = (2 ** h) - 1
  left_leaf_nodes = 2 ** (h - 1)

  if n > left_leaf_nodes && is_move_left == true
    solve(h - 1, n - left_leaf_nodes, sum + left_all_nodes + 1, true)
  else
    solve(h - 1, n, sum + 1, !is_move_left)
  end
end

def pair(x)
  return [0,1] if x == "U"
  return [0,-1] if x == "D"
  return [-1,0] if x == "L"
  return [1,0] if x == "R"
  return [0,0]
end

def build(mov)
  moves = [[0,0]]
  mov.split(//).each_with_index do |x| 
    p = pair(x)
    moves << [moves.last[0] + p[0], moves.last[1] + p[1]]
  end
  {:dx => moves.last[0] - 0, :dy => moves.last[1] - 0, :moves => moves}
end

def run(mov,a,b)
  f = build(mov)
  dx = f[:dx]
  dy = f[:dy]
  f[:moves].each do |x|
    return "Yes" if matches(a,b,dx,dy,x[0],x[1]) 
  end
  return "No"
end

class Integer
  def divisers
    n=self
    res = []
    res << 1
    i=1
    while i*i <= n
      if n%i==0
        res << i
        res << n/i if i*i!=n
      end
      i+=1
    end
    res.sort!
  end
end

def solve n,m,k
  ds = n.divisers
  if n-1+m-1<k
    return -1
  end
  ans=0
  for w1 in ds
    k1=n/w1-1
    k2=k-k1
    if 0<=k1 && k1<=k && 0<=k2 && k2<=k
      w2=m/(k2+1)
      ans = [ans, w1*w2].max
    end
  end
  ans
end

def same(pos, p)
  4.times do | i |
    if pos[i] == p then return i end
    if pos[i] == (p[2..3] + p[0..1]) then return i end
  end
  return -1
end
def solve(pos , xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
  ans = Array.new
  ans[0] = same(pos, [xmin, ymin, xmin, ymax])
  ans[1] = same(pos, [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymin])
  ans[2] = same(pos, [xmin, ymax, xmax, ymax])
  ans[3] = same(pos, [xmax, ymin, xmax, ymax])
#  p ans
  ans.sort!
  4.times do |i|
    if ans[i] != i then return false end
  end
  return true
end

def solve(string)
  res = Matcher.match(string)
  i = res[:int].split("")
  f = res[:float].split("")
  e = res[:exp].to_i
  buf1 = i + f.take(e)
  buf2 = f.drop(e)
  if(buf2.empty?)
    buf4 = buf1.drop_while{|x| x == "0"}
    if(e > f.length)
      buf3 = (0..(e-f.length - 1)).map{ "0" }
      "#{buf4.join("")}#{buf3.join("")}"
    else
      "#{buf4.join("")}"
    end
  else
    buf4 = buf1.drop_while{|x| x == "0"}
    if(buf4.empty?)
      "0.#{buf2.join("")}"
    else
      "#{buf4.join("")}.#{buf2.join("")}"
    end
  end
end

def is_able?(n)
  xc = n / $x
  yc = n / $y
  bc = n / $x.lcm($y)
  a_left = [$a - yc - bc, 0].max
  b_left = [$b - xc - bc, 0].max
  a_left + b_left <= n - xc - yc + bc
end

def magic(l, r)
  return l if l == r
  m = (l + r) / 2
  is_able?(m) ? magic(l, m) : magic(m + 1, r)
end

    for i in 0 ... ((n+1)/2)

def is_prime( n )
	
	return false if n % 2 == 0 && n != 2

	div = 3
	while( div * div <= n )
		return false if n % div == 0
		div += 2
	end

	return true;
end

def edge(v, u)
	cv = cu = 1
	res = 1
	[u, v].min.times do |i|
		cv = cv * (v - i)
		cv %= MOD
		cu = cu * (u - i) / (i + 1)
		cu %= MOD
		res += (cu * cv) % MOD
		res %= MOD
	end
	res
end

class Matrix2x2
  attr_accessor :a, :b, :c, :d
  def initialize(a=0,b=0,c=0,d=0)
    @a = a
    @b = b
    @c = c
    @d = d
  end
end

def mult(x, y)
  z = Matrix2x2.new
  z.a = x.a*y.a + x.b*y.c
  z.b = x.a*y.b + x.b*y.d
  z.c = x.c*y.a + x.d*y.c
  z.d = x.c*y.b + x.d*y.d
  z
end

def expt(a, p)
  if p == 1
    a.clone
  elsif p % 2 == 1
    t = expt(a, p-1)
    mult(a, t)
  else
    t = expt(a, p/2)
    mult(t, t)
  end
end

def get_eaten(n, k)
  eaten = 0
  rem = n
  # puts rem if @d1
  # puts "---" if @d1
  while rem > 0 do
    # puts rem if @dbg
    if rem >= k
      eaten += k
      rem -= k
    else
      eaten += rem
      rem = 0
    end
    # puts rem if @d1
    rem -= (0.1 * rem).floor
    # puts rem if @d1
    # puts eaten if @d1
    # puts "eod" if @d1
  end
  eaten
end

    DateTime.new(today[2], today[1], today[0], 0, 0, 0) - DateTime.new(today[2], birthday[1], birthday[0], 0, 0, 0) >= 0
  end
end

    dx += 1 if ch == 'R'
    dx -= 1 if ch == 'L'
    dy += 1 if ch == 'U'
    dy -= 1 if ch == 'D'
    dp << [dx, dy]
  end

  dx, dy = dp[-1]
  dp.each do |cur|
    x = a - cur[0]
    y = b - cur[1]
    chk = 0
    mul = x / dy if dy != 0
    mul = y / dy if dy != 0
    next if mul < 0
    return true if dx * mul == x && dy * mul == y
  end
  return false
end

class Array
    def diameter
        m = 0
        for i in 0...self.count
            for j in i+1...self.count
                t = (self[i]-self[j]).abs
                if t>m
                    m = t
                end
            end
        end
        m
    end

    def complect_and_count
        self.dup.complect_and_count!
    end

    def complect_and_count!
        a = self.shift
        h = {a => 1}
        k = 1
        while self.size>0
            b = self.shift
            if a != b
                h[a] = k
                h[b] = 1
                k = 0
            end
            a = b
            k += 1
        end
        h[b]=k
        h
    end
end

def calc(m, k, filters)
  return 0 if k >= m

  socket_count = k - 1
  filter_count = 1

  filters.sort_by! { |x| -x }
  filters.each do |item|
    return filter_count if item + socket_count >= m

    socket_count += item - 1
    filter_count += 1
  end

  return -1
end

def color_to_bitmask(color)
  case color
  when 'B'
    bitmask = 0b00001
  when 'Y'
    bitmask = 0b00010
  when 'W'
    bitmask = 0b00100
  when 'G'
    bitmask = 0b01000
  when 'R'
    bitmask = 0b10000
  end
end

def card_strings_to_card_bitmasks(card_strings)
  card_strings.map {
    |c|
    color = c[0]
    value = c[1].to_i
    
    color_to_bitmask(color) * 0b100000 + 2 ** (value - 1)
  }
end

def check_ops_for_pair(ops, a, b)
  if a != b 
    (a ^ b) & ops > 0
  else true
  end
end

def combinations(i1)
  (0...(i1.size-1)).inject([]) {|pairs,x| pairs += ((x+1)...i1.size).map {|y| [i1[x],i1[y]]}}
end

def check_ops_for_combinations(ops, combinations)
  combinations.inject { 
    |result, combination|
    a, b = combination
    check = check_ops_for_pair(ops, a, b)
    if not check
      break(false) 
    end
    check
  }
end

  i=0
  sum = 0
  sz = ary.size
  while i<sz do
    sum += ary[i]
    if sum == ss
      sum = 0
    elsif sum > ss
      return false
    end
    i += 1
  end
  sum == 0
end

def f(a,b)
  c=0
  x = Prime.prime_division(a)
  while b>0 do
    tmp = b
    x.each do |ar|
      tmp = [tmp, b%ar[0]].min
    end
    c += tmp
    b -= tmp
    x.each do |ar|
      while b%ar[0]==0
        b/=ar[0]
        ar[1]-=1
        x.delete(ar) if ar[1]==0
      end
    end
  end
  return c
end

  rtn = ""

    n = (n.to_i / 7).to_s
  end
  return rtn
end

    rtn += n[i].to_i * 7 ** (n.size - i - 1)

  return rtn
end

def fill_primes(max)
  primes = [2,3]
  now = primes[-1]
  loop{
    now+=2
    break if now>max
    prime, check = true, 0
    while primes[check]**2 <= now:
      prime = false if now%primes[check]==0
      break if not prime
      check+=1
    end
    primes << now if prime
  }
  return primes
end

def is_almost_prime(num, primes)
  check = 0
  divisors = [1]
  while num>1
    while num % primes[check] == 0
      num /= primes[check]
      divisors << primes[check] if divisors[-1] != primes[check]
    end
    check+=1
  end
  if divisors.length == 3
    1
  else
    0
  end
end

class Integer
  def divisor_list
    return [] if self <= 0
    return [1] if self == 1

    prime_division.map.with_index { |(base, k), i|
      s = i.zero? ? 0 : 1
      (s..k).map { |n| base ** n }
    }.inject { |res, e| res + res.flat_map { |t| e.map { |v| t * v } } }.sort
  end
end

        return (c1 == 0 ? -1 : 0)
      elsif a1 == 0 or b1 == 0

      else

  det2 = a1*c2-a2*c1
  det3 = b1*c2-b2*c1

class Grid
  def initialize(gridStr)
    @numX = gridStr.count('X')
    @num0 = gridStr.count('0')
    @numP = gridStr.count('.')
    split = gridStr.split("\n")
    @lines = split.map { |line| line.split("") }
    @num_winning_rows = how_many_in_a_row?
  end

  def analyze
    return "illegal" if is_illegal?
    return "draw" if is_draw?
    return "the second player won" if second_won?
    return "the first player won" if first_won?
    return "second" if second_turn?
    return "first" if first_turn?
  end

  def is_illegal?
    return true if @num0 > @numX
    return true if @numX > @num0 + 1
    return true unless @numX + @num0 + @numP == 9
    return true if too_many_wins?
  end

  def is_draw?
    return false if @num_winning_rows > 0
    return true if @numX + @num0 == 9
  end

  def second_won?
    return false if too_many_wins?
    return @ohWins
  end

  def first_won?
    return false if too_many_wins?
    return @xWins
  end

  def second_turn?
    @numX == @num0 + 1
  end

  def first_turn?
    @numX == @num0
  end

  def how_many_in_a_row?
    num = 0
    (0..2).each { |col| num += 1 if horizontal_win(col) }
    (0..2).each { |row| num += 1 if vertical_win(row) }
    num += 1 if left_right_win
    num += 1 if right_left_win
    num
  end

  def horizontal_win(xPos)
    return false unless @lines[xPos][0] == "X" || @lines[xPos][0] == "0"
    if @lines[xPos][0] == @lines[xPos][1] && @lines[xPos][1] == @lines[xPos][2]
      set_winner(@lines[xPos][0])
      @horizontal_winner = true
      return true
    end
  end

  def vertical_win(yPos)
    return false unless @lines[0][yPos] == "X" || @lines[0][yPos] == "0"
    if @lines[0][yPos] == @lines[1][yPos] && @lines[1][yPos] == @lines[2][yPos]
      set_winner(@lines[0][yPos])
      @vertical_winner = true
      return true
    end
  end

  def left_right_win
    return false unless @lines[0][0] == "X" || @lines[0][0] == "0"
    if @lines[0][0] == @lines[1][1] && @lines[1][1] == @lines[2][2]
      set_winner(@lines[0][0])
      @diag_winner = true
      return true
    end
  end

  def right_left_win
    return false unless @lines[2][0] == "X" || @lines[2][0] == "0"
    if @lines[2][0] == @lines[1][1] && @lines[1][1] == @lines[0][2]
      set_winner(@lines[2][0])
      @diag_winner = true
      return true
    end
  end

  def set_winner(player)
    @xWins = true if player == "X"
    @ohWins = true if player == "0"
  end

  def too_many_wins?
    return false if @num_winning_rows == 1 || @num_winning_rows == 0
    return true if @num_winning_rows > 2
    winner = @xWins ? "X" : "0"
    return true if @horizontal_winner && !@diag_winner && !@vertical_winner
    return true if @vertical_winner && !@diag_winner && !@horizontal_winner
    return false
  end
end

class Board
  WEIGHTS = { q: 9, r: 5, b: 3, k: 3, p: 1 }

  def initialize(lines)
    @pieces = lines.join.chars
  end

  def which_to_win?
    case
    when score('white') > score('black')
      'White'
    when score('white') == score('black')
      'Draw'
    else
      'Black'
    end
  end

  private

  def score(color)
    selector = (color == 'white') ? ('A'..'Z').to_a : ('a'..'z').to_a

    @pieces.select { |piece| selector.include? piece }.map do |piece|
      weight piece
    end.inject(0, :+)
  end

  def weight(piece)
    key = piece.downcase.to_sym

    WEIGHTS.key?(key) ? WEIGHTS[key] : 0
  end
end

require 'prime'

def lcd(a, b)
  temp = {}
  a.prime_division.each {|p|
    temp[p[0]] = p[1]
  }
  b.prime_division.each {|p|
    if temp.has_key? p[0]
      temp[p[0]] += p[1]
    else
      temp[p[0]] = p[1]
    end
  }
  temp.keys.reduce(1) {|a, n| a * (n**temp[n])}
end

def solve(input, output)
  n, m, z = parse_int_array(input[0])
  output << (z/lcd(n, m)).to_s
end

class Tram
  attr_reader(:s, :x1, :x2, :t1, :t2, :p, :d)
  def initialize(s, x1, x2, t1, t2, p, d)
    @s = s
    @x1 = x1
    @x2 = x2
    @t1 = t1
    @t2 = t2
    @p = p
    @d = d
  end

  def direction
    x2.compare(x1)
  end

  def by_foot
    (x1 - x2).abs * t2
  end

  def wait_time
    if(direction == d)
      if(d == -1)
        if(p <= x1)
         (((p + s) + (s - x1)))  * t1
        else
          (x1 - p).abs * t1
        end
      else
        if(p <= x1)
          (x1 - p).abs * t1
        else
         ((s - p) + s + x1)  * t1
        end
      end
    else
      if(d == -1)
        (p * t1) + (x1 * t1)
      else
        ((s - p) * t1) + ((s - x1) * t1)
      end
    end
  end

  def tram_time
    (x1 - x2).abs * t1
  end

  def by_tram
    wait_time + tram_time
  end
end

def chrnum(ch)
  if ch >= "0" && ch <= "9"
    return ch.to_i
  end
  return ch.ord - 55
end

def strnum(str, rdx)
  ret = 0
  mult = 1
  str.reverse!.each_byte{|s|
    ret += chrnum(s.chr)*mult
    mult *= rdx
  }
  return ret
end

def get_sumator(arr)
    return -1 if arr.length > 3
    case arr.length
    when 1
        return 0
    when 2
        max = arr.max
        min = arr.min
        if (max - min) % 2 == 0
            return (max - min) / 2
        else
            return (max - min)
        end
    when 3
        max = arr[-1]
        min = arr[0]
        # if the average of max and min is the same as
        # the middle one it can be done
        if (max + min) / 2 == arr[1]
            return (max - min)/ 2
        else
            return -1
        end
    else
        return -1
    end
end

    case i

        ret << '7' * (num.size / 2 - counts['7'])

def get_valid_pairs(dpa, i)
    pairs = []
    for j in 0..((i/2).floor) do
        if dpa[j] != -1 && dpa[i-j] != -1 
            pairs.push([j, i-j])
        end 
    end
    return pairs
end

# Find the best solution for i
def get_result(dpa, i)
    pairs = get_valid_pairs(dpa, i)
    best = -1
    for j in 0..(pairs.length - 1) do
        ans = dpa[pairs[j][0]] + dpa[pairs[j][1]]
        best = ans if ans > best
    end
    return best
end

class StrangeDevice
  def initialize(n, m)
    @m = m
    @array = [n]
  end

  def minimum_times
    t = 0
    until @array.include?(@m)
      operate
      t += 1
    end

    t
  end

  def self.minimum_times(n, m)
    new(n, m).minimum_times
  end

  private

  def operate
    @array = [].tap do |out|
      @array.each do |a|
        out << a * 2
        out << a - 1
      end
    end
  end
end

    return false if x <= 1
    (2..x).each do |i|

    n = x + 1
    while !prime? n
        n += 1
    end
    n

def min(m, s)
	a = [0] * m
	a[0] = 1
	
	return -1 if s < 1
	
	ms = s - 1
	i = m - 1
	while ms > 0
		if i == 0
			if ms < 9
				a[i] += ms
				break
			else
				return -1
			end
		else
			a[i] = [9, ms].min
			ms -= a[i]
			i -= 1
		end
	end
	
	return a.join
end

def max(m, s)
	a = [0] * m
	
	return -1 if s < 1
	
	i = 0
	while s > 0
		if i == m - 1
			if s <= 9
				a[i] = s
				break
			else
				return -1
			end
		else
			a[i] = [9, s].min
			s -= a[i]
			i += 1
		end
	end

def gcd(x, y)
  x_divisor = divisor x
  y_divisor = divisor y
  common_divisor = x_divisor & y_divisor
  return common_divisor.max
end

def divisor(x)
  divisor = [1]
  Primes.each do |p|
    divisor << p if x%p == 0
  end
  unless Primes.include? x then
    divisor << x
  end
  return divisor
end

  next_must_be_vowel = false

  word.chars.each do |c|

    return false if next_must_be_vowel && is_consonant(c)

    next_must_be_vowel =
      c != ?a &&
      c != ?e &&
      c != ?i &&
      c != ?o &&
      c != ?u &&
      c != ?n
  end

  !next_must_be_vowel
end

def getmask(number)
  number_length = number.to_s.length
  i = 1
  result = ''
  while i <= number_length do
    digit = number % 10
    number = number / 10
    result << digit.to_s if [4,7].include?(digit)
    i+=1
  end
  
  result.reverse.to_i
end

def pow(n)
  n*n
end

class Circle
  attr_accessor :x, :y, :r
  def initialize(x, y, r)
    @x = x
    @y = y
    @r = r
  end

  def include?(other)
    pow(@x-other.x) + pow(@y-other.y) <= pow(@r-other.r)
  end

  def collide?(other)
    (not include?(other)) and pow(@x-other.x) + pow(@y-other.y) < pow(@r+other.r)
  end
end

        @next = nil
    end

# @param {Integer} val
# @return {ListNode}
def remove_elements(head, val)
  p = head
  h = nil
  t = nil
  until p.nil?
    if p.val != val
      s = ListNode.new(p.val)
      if h.nil?
        h = t = s
      else
        t.next = s
        t = s
      end
    end
    p = p.next
  end
  h

end

POSSIBLES = [
  [[1, 2], [18, 20], [11, 12], [13, 15]],
  [[3, 4], [17, 19], [9, 10], [14, 16]],
  [[2, 4], [6, 8], [10, 12], [21, 23]],
  [[1, 3], [5, 7], [9, 11], [22, 24]],
]


FACES = [
  (1..4).to_a,
  (5..8).to_a,
  (9..12).to_a,
  (13..16).to_a,
  (17..20).to_a,
  (21..24).to_a,
]

def check_solved(c)
  FACES.each do |face|
    return false unless face.map { |f| c[f] }.uniq.size == 1
  end
  true
end

def solve(cube)
  # [[[2, 4], [6, 8], [10, 12], [21, 23]]].each_with_index do |possib|
  POSSIBLES.each_with_index do |possib|
    face_colors = possib.map { |p| cube[p.first] == cube[p.last] }
    next if face_colors.include?(false)
    colors = possib.map { |p| cube[p.first] }
    [possib.rotate(1), possib.rotate(-1)].each do |rot|
      c = cube.dup
      rot.each_with_index do |curr, i|
        c[curr.first] = colors[i]
        c[curr.last] = colors[i]
      end
      if check_solved(c)
        return "YES"
      end
    end
  end
  return "NO"
end

def equality(n)
	l = 0
	essai = 0
	nombre = 2
	while n > essai
		divi = n.to_f / nombre
		l = l + 1 if divi.to_s[divi.to_s.index(".") + 1] == "0"
		nombre = nombre + 1
		essai = essai + 1
	end
	return l
end

  return 1 if k == 0
  return n if(k == 1)
  ans = 1
  if((k%2) == 0)
    ans *= k2(k/2,n,m)**2
  else
    ans *= k2(k-1,n,m)
    ans *= n
  end
  return ans % m
end

def recur_tree(visited, acc, depth)
    #puts "#{'>' * (depth+1)} #{visited} #{acc}"
    if acc >= $n
        if acc == $n
            if !visited
                return 0
            else
                return 1
            end
        else
            return 0 # exceeded
        end
    end

    sub_ways = 0

    for i in 1..$k
        sub_ways += recur_tree(visited || (i >= $d), acc + i, depth + 1)
    end

    return sub_ways
end
